newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks higher, blue chips ease further.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks higher, blue chips ease further.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in subdued trade on Tuesday, with further mild losses in blue chips and new gains in hotelier issues.
* Eight of 12 active issues rose and 4 fell.
* Volume was lower at 8,418 shares, turnover shrank to 3.0 million kuna.
* Top gainer was hotelier Istraturist, up 18 kuna or 7.28 percent to 248 kuna on volume of 154 shares.
* Biggest decliner, food processor Podravka, lost nine kuna or 2.5 percent to 350 kuna. It was also the most active issue with 3,520 units sold.
